weddingBoard.storyBody:
Two people, miles apart, somehow found each other through a screen, and from the very beginning, there was a feeling that this was different.

We recognized something special almost immediately. Edwin knew he had found his wife, and Lordina knew there was something incredibly special about the man who had entered her life.

What began with messages soon became hours of conversations, endless laughter, late-night calls, prayers, plans, and a connection that made thousands of miles feel insignificant. Somewhere between the calls, the visits, the inside jokes, and simply doing life together from opposite sides of the world, we became home to one another.

Our love has crossed countries, time zones, and an ocean, yet loving each other has always felt like the easiest part.

Through it all, our love has been rooted in something greater than the two of us. We believe our love is biblical, written by God long before we knew each other. A love grounded in faith, strengthened through prayer, covered by grace, and built on the promise of choosing each other, again and again.

We found friendship, partnership, and a love that felt familiar from the very beginning, almost as though God was simply introducing us to someone He already knew belonged in our story.

And now, the two people who once stared at each other through phone screens are preparing to stand before God, our families, and the people we love most and say, “I do.”

From miles apart to forever side by side, a love story written by God, lived by us, and only just beginning.
